mapper.insert: insert ignore into user_notification (event_id, user_id, order_id, notification_type, title, content, read_status, read_time, create_time) values (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{readStatus}, #{readTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from user_notification where user_id = #{userId} and read_status = 0
